electrodes.cue: Right arm electrode — the right infraclavicular fossa, just below the lateral third of the clavicle, on flat skin off the deltoid.
electrodes.correction: RA placement incorrect — move to the right infraclavicular fossa, just below the lateral third of the right clavicle, on flat skin away from the deltoid muscle belly.

electrodes.cue: Left arm electrode — the left infraclavicular fossa, mirroring RA.
electrodes.correction: LA placement incorrect — move to the left infraclavicular fossa, just below the lateral third of the left clavicle, mirroring the right arm electrode.

electrodes.cue: Right leg electrode — the right lower abdomen below the umbilicus, or the right thigh. This is the driven reference electrode.
electrodes.correction: RL placement incorrect — move to the right lower abdomen below the level of the umbilicus, or the right thigh. It is the reference electrode rather than a recording one, but the tracing is noisy without it.

electrodes.cue: Left leg electrode — the left lower abdomen below the umbilicus, or the left thigh, mirroring RL.
electrodes.correction: LL placement incorrect — move to the left lower abdomen below the level of the umbilicus, or the left thigh, mirroring the right leg electrode.

electrodes.cue: V1 — fourth intercostal space at the right sternal border. Find the sternal angle: the space beside it is the second, then count down two more.
electrodes.correction: V1 placement incorrect — move to the fourth intercostal space at the right sternal border.

electrodes.cue: V2 — fourth intercostal space at the left sternal border, directly opposite V1.
electrodes.correction: V2 placement incorrect — move to the fourth intercostal space at the left sternal border, mirroring V1 across the sternum.

electrodes.cue: V3 — midway between V2 and V4. Place V4 first, then put V3 between them.
electrodes.correction: V3 placement incorrect — move it midway along a straight line between V2 and V4. Position V4 first, then place V3 between them.

electrodes.cue: V4 — fifth intercostal space in the left midclavicular line. On a female patient it goes on the chest wall beneath the breast, not on it.
electrodes.correction: V4 placement incorrect — move to the fifth intercostal space in the left midclavicular line. On a female patient, displace breast tissue upwards and place the electrode on the chest wall beneath it.

electrodes.cue: V5 — left anterior axillary line, horizontally level with V4.
electrodes.correction: V5 placement incorrect — move to the left anterior axillary line at the same horizontal level as V4, not down along the rib below it.

electrodes.cue: V6 — left midaxillary line, horizontally level with V4 and V5.
electrodes.correction: V6 placement incorrect — move to the left midaxillary line, level with V4 and V5. V4, V5 and V6 sit on one horizontal line rather than following the curve of a rib.
